claim.claim-text: 1. An end effector for use with a surgical instrument, comprising:

a first jaw member (250a) defining a longitudinal axis ("B"); a second jaw member (250b), wherein the first jaw member (250a) is movable toward the second jaw member (250b); and a cam pin (224d), wherein:

the first jaw member (250a) has a first cam slot (300a) defined therein, wherein the first cam slot (300a) defines a first portion (310a) having a first slope relative to the longitudinal axis and a second portion (320a) having a second slope relative to the longitudinal axis, and the cam pin (224d) is slidingly received in the first cam slot (300a), whereby longitudinal distal movement of the cam pin (224d) along the cam slot causes the first jaw member (250a) to move towards the second jaw member (250b), wherein said longitudinal distal movement of the cam pin (224d) along the first portion (310a) of the first cam slot (300a) causes initial movement of the first jaw member (250a) relative to the second jaw member (250b), and said longitudinal distal movement of the cam pin (224d) along the second portion (320a) of the first cam slot (300a) causes additional movement of the first jaw member (250a) relative to the second jaw member (250b).

2. The end effector according to claim 2, wherein the first portion (310a) of the first cam slot (300a) is disposed proximally of the second portion (320a) of the first cam slot, and wherein the first slope of the first cam slot (300a) defines a steeper angle relative to the longitudinal axis ("B") than the second slope of the first cam slot (300a).

3. The end effector according to claim 1 or 2, wherein the first portion (310a) of the first cam slot (300a) is disposed proximally of the second portion (320a) of the first cam slot, and wherein the first portion (310a) of the first cam slot (300a) defines a shorter length than a length of the second portion (320a) of the first cam slot.
4. The end effector according to claim 2, wherein a first angle ("α") defined by the first slope of the first cam slot (300a) relative to the longitudinal axis ("B") is between 35° and 45°.
5. The end effector according to claim 4, wherein a second angle ("β") defined by the second slope of the first cam slot (300a) relative to the longitudinal axis ("B") is between 15° and 20°.
6. The end effector according to claim 3, wherein the first portion (310a) of the first cam slot (300a) defines a length of between 1.9mm (0.075 inches) and 3.18mm (0.125) inches.
7. The end effector according to claim 6, wherein the second portion (320a) of the first cam slot (300a) defines a length of between 4.45mm (0.175 inches) and 5.72mm (0.225 inches).
8. The end effector according to any preceding claim, wherein the second jaw member (250b) includes a second cam slot (300b) configured to slidingly receive the cam pin (224d).

9. The end effector according to claim 8, wherein the second cam slot (300b) defines a first portion (310b) having a first slope relative to a longitudinal axis of the second jaw member (250b) and a second portion (320b) having second slope relative to the longitudinal axis to the second jaw member.
10. The end effector according to claim 8 or 9, wherein the second cam slot (300b) of the second jaw member (250b) mirrors the first cam slot (300a) of the first jaw member (250a).

11. The end effector according to any preceding claim, wherein the first cam slot (300a) defines a transition area (330a) interconnecting the first portion (310a) of the first cam slot and the second portion (320a) of the first cam slot.
12. The end effector according to any preceding claim, wherein the end effector is for a surgical clip applier.
13. The end effector according to claim 12, further comprising a surgical clip received between the first jaw member (250a) and the second jaw member (250b).
